payload.claim: The REVIEW_INCOMPLETE override at 3997-4000 sets both result.state and result.why, but the one test that reaches this branch with cut already True (test_beside_a_lens_with_an_error_rebuts_own_stops_stand_and_a_cut_ends_incomplete, cell 5, a REBUT cap cut beside a lens error) asserts only outcome5.state, outcome5.rebut_result and rebuttal5['state']; it never checks rebuttal5['why'] or the REBUT line. Acceptance criterion 2 explicitly promises that in this case 'its REBUT line and rebuttal.json carry criterion 1's line' (review.incomplete_after_rebut's text), but no witness proves it: making result.why skip reassignment specifically when cut was true (restoring the cap-cut's own budget message instead of incomplete_after_rebut's line) leaves cell 5's assertions, and every other cell in both tests, green, since those other cells never combine a lens error with a cap cut.
